title: Audit-only executable hazard proofs

proofs.boundary: Real generateDxfBySheet source with synthetic valid placed piece and one front hole; no mocks.
proofs.observation: Same hole: non-rotated output has 1 CIRCLE; rotated output has 0 CIRCLE, retains piece outline and successful EOF.
limitations: Not a machine/CAM readback or controller compatibility proof.
The exporter explicitly documents non-rotated-only drilling; evidence proves omission, not that a transform convention is defined. Product safety concern is using output as complete CNC drilling.

proofs.boundary: Real resolveProjectDrilling and underlying BOM/resolver with existing plantilla fixture; audit input preserves hardware IDs but removes optional machining profiles.
proofs.observation: 8 resolved patterns, 7 fallbackUsed=true; exported data.patterns has 0 fallbackUsed fields and no issues fields; hole arrays remain identical.
limitations: Fixture has zero nonempty geometry issue lists; proves fields stripped and real fallback flags lost, not suppression of an actual geometry error in this runtime fixture.
First harness attempt removed required hardware IDs and failed BOM validation; retained in defect-proofs-first-attempt.log, corrected fixture only.

proofs.boundary: Real createPurchasingStore; repository transport/state simulated in memory; UI toast/workspace imports mocked.
proofs.observation: Successful debit 2 followed by failed picking persistence leaves stock 10→8 and picking pendiente. Retry after in-flight lock release leaves stock 8→6; two debit calls and zero compensation calls.
limitations: Not HTTP/Go/PostgreSQL/RLS E2E; fake repository deliberately accepts stock calls and rejects picking calls.
Proves missing client compensation and retry orchestration only; does not claim verified DB balance or prove actual endpoint outage.

constraints: No product fixes or source writes.
Green assertions mean hazards were reproduced, not remediation or production readiness.
